secondaryAnomaliesObserved: SerpApi rejected the raw location string 'San Telmo' on every grounded-search call (both COLD attempts and the WARM attempt), falling back to a location-less query automatically each time -- identical behavior to the Google control spike, so this is a shared/provider-independent grounding-precision issue, not Geoapify-specific.

Geoapify-specific: 'GeoapifyPlacesApiService: Geoapify Places text search requires a locationBias to search safely; skipped query: "San Telmo"' logged once per run -- Geoapify's own text-search safety guard skipped a plain-text query the Google backend would have attempted; this did not block the run (the NEARBY-shaped GENERIC acquisition still produced 16 real observations).
Wikidata proximity lookups failed repeatedly (mix of HTTP 429 and 10s timeouts) throughout COLD; best-effort per architecture, did not block generation -- same pattern as the Google spike.
Groq rate-limited one extraction call (429, output-token-per-minute limit) during COLD; self-healed via existing retry/backoff -- same pattern as the Google spike.
No Geoapify quota/rate-limit failures observed in either run (unlike the Google spike, which exhausted its Google Places SearchTextRequest daily quota mid-COLD-run).
